pre_registered_decision_gates.go: At 5 cm, combined object anomaly AP exceeds error prevalence by at least 0.10 and top-20% error rate is at least 2x bottom-20% in both scenes; direction agrees at two or more voxel scales.
pre_registered_decision_gates.modify: Separation appears in only one scene, one scale, or one error family; retain the useful component but do not claim a unified trigger.
pre_registered_decision_gates.stop: No stable top-vs-bottom separation, or voxel scoring does not improve over the non-spatial object label-histogram baseline.
